verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs state that users can install and connect MCP servers and use their tools with local models, so it acts as an MCP client. One hands-on report describes a rough first experience (an infinite loop while fetching an HN headline), but it implies the MCP connection worked and does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: detailed setup/configuration documentation (e.g., how servers are registered, supported transports, tool-permission controls), and independent corroboration of reliable tool use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: You can install MCP servers in LM Studio and use them with your local models.
